nodes.text: @ValerieTreg @valerie5462 If it's HMPV, that one's been circulating for decades, & most people already have some immunity for it. The article I read said it's just not a familiar name because it's not routinely tested for, & usually has regular cold symptoms in otherwise healthy people.

nodes.author: BestWordSalad
nodes.text: @ValerieTreg @valerie5462 But like any respiratory illness, if a person already has issues like COPD or emphysema, they might end up with more serious symptoms since they're already somewhat compromised.
